method.results: opponent-adjusted scoring margin, margins capped at 28, home advantage measured from the season itself
method.carryover: prior seasons decayed at 0.55 and scaled by the MEASURED season-on-season slope
method.roster: returning production and portal movement from committed roster datasets; transfer pedigree is EdgeDesk’s own rating of the program left
method.availability: high-impact absences only, this week only, reversible
not_included: NIL spending — no public feed carries it
per-player recruiting stars — absent from the public roster feed
coaching and coordinator continuity — no public feed is wired
anything a poll, a service or another model asserts

carryover.note: last season predicts this one LESS than it used to — the portal era showing up in the arithmetic

hfa.basis: half the mean home margin over 3568 games
half the mean home margin over 3576 games
half the mean home margin over 3606 games
half the mean home margin over 3699 games
half the mean home margin over 95 games

p4_scope.basis: the 2025 Power 4 membership — the latest season the trained universe carries. 2026 realignment is NOT reflected in this grouping, and each team’s conference itself still comes from the 2026 schedule feed.

notes: no high-impact availability on file — that component is zero for every team
